blocking_findings.severity: blocks PR #174 merge; precondition for the worlds publish
blocking_findings.failure: PR #174 ships celestial as version 0.6.0, but its stellar_ld.ail differs from the published registry 0.6.0. `cmp` against ~/.ailang/cache/registry/sunholo/celestial/0.6.0/stellar_ld.ail: 00f0c7f matches the published file, bac2d61 differs. There is no CHANGELOG entry for the change. worlds/ailang.lock:8 pins the path celestial content_hash sha256:4ee2c89d..., while the game lock's registry celestial 0.6.0 is sha256:1f060862.... Merging would leave main's celestial 0.6.0 different from the registry's 0.6.0 under the same version number.
blocking_findings.fix: Either bump celestial to 0.6.1 (kind fix, CHANGELOG: batched ldRows, no API or result change), publish it and point worlds at it, or drop bac2d61 and c309d36 from #174. Then re-lock worlds against a registry-identical celestial.

blocking_findings.failure: AC14 asks for tests of three things: (a) every HZ rocky planet around an M dwarf is HabitabilityDebated; (b) no Other-class host is habitable; (c) a measured constraint forbids a biosphere in every seed. Only (b) is asserted. HabitabilityDebated is imported but never asserted in any test. The trappist-1b veto is exercised only through preparedEqual (two code paths agree), never as 'no biosphere for any seed or dial'. The census asserts moments, nesting and growth, but not the labels (design W2.2 says it should).
blocking_findings.fix: Add worlds_test cases: an M-dwarf HZ rocky synthetic and a measured planet give HabitabilityDebated; a TRAPPIST-1 b-like planet placed in the HZ stays Sterile over many seeds with the Teeming dial; add census assertions that zero M-dwarf planets are Habitable and that zero synthesised planets around veto-class stars exceed 3 m/s (AC15).

non_blocking_findings.issue: Every synthesised HZ planet is exactly 1.0 R_E and 1.0 M_E, yet its cite says 'masses: adopted Chen-Kipping median likelihood/log-mass prior'. Those exact values go on the 2.17 wire in worlds.system. This is an assumption shown as if exact, with a mislabelled source (standing order 2026-10-30).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Either sample radius in 0.5-1.5 R_E (Bryson's eta-Earth range) with a Chen-Kipping mass, or give the hz slot its own cite: 'radius and mass assumed Earth-like'.

non_blocking_findings.issue: The JWST atmosphere veto is a hard-coded id and name list inside the model module, not data, and it bites only on planets that are outside the HZ anyway (TRAPPIST-1 b, c).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Move it to sim/data/worlds_rules.ail as cited constraint rows.

non_blocking_findings.issue: The rocky test uses radius 0.5-1.5 R_E OR msini 0.1-5 M_E, so a measured radius above 1.5 R_E can still count as rocky through msini. In the snapshot this affects 2 planets (e.g. HD 3167 b, 1.60 R_E with msini 4.84 M_E), none of them in the HZ of a registry host.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: When a radius is measured, let it decide; fall back to msini only when there is no radius.

non_blocking_findings.issue: An unknown preset id silently becomes Stapledon's Voyage.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Reject unknown ids in new_game (an error reply).

non_blocking_findings.issue: With an ideal 10-ly support, the development calibration (0-2 detected) says nothing about whether the bands are feasible. The report's 'the search reports conflicts' is true but vacuous at this support. The calibration is honestly labelled photon_budget=false, calibrated=false, and the final presets and slice seed are explicitly deferred, so this is correctly scoped, not overclaimed.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: When S2 lands, re-probe the budget; a 256-seed x 4-strategy run will probably exceed 30 min (linear extrapolation is already flagged).

non_blocking_findings.issue: The draft's unlock is anthropic_reveal, and it says 'This one was selected'. Design W2.5 (worlds.md:389-393) wants the unlock first_planet_host and no hint, teaching the baseline's 0.05 civilisations with LW checks for rho0, R*, f_p and eta-Earth. The README proposes this change, but the execution report does not list it as a design deviation. All three drafts carry almost no numbers, against the Archive real-physics standing order.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Mark rules: either a separate reveal entry plus a no-hint drake-factors entry as designed, or amend W2.5.

non_blocking_findings.issue: I opened all four; their sha256 match mockup-evidence.md, and they are not blank or duplicated. The physics is right: TRAPPIST-1 Teq at A=0.3 matches Agol 2021 scaled by 0.7^0.25; the HZ 0.0246-0.0498 AU puts e, f, g inside; the alpha Cen A HZ 1.17-2.06 AU matches sqrt(L/S). Presentation issues: alpha Cen A b (an 11.8 R_E candidate giant) is filled mint green by Teq, which reads like the 'rocky, conservative zone' green; labels overlap at 81 ly (tau Ceti, Sol); the frames carry far more prose than W2.4's 'words last' allows ('What we know', footnotes).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Use a non-green palette for Teq, or outline-only fills for non-rocky planets; declutter labels; trim the copy to the six allowed words.

non_blocking_findings.issue: Spot-checked against the literature: Kopparapu 2014 coefficients, solar HZ 0.950/1.676 AU, Earth Teq 255 K, RV 12.5/0.0895 m/s, transit 0.00465, SAG13 (0.38,-0.19,0.26 / 0.73,-1.18,0.59; P in years), Sandberg f_l median 1-1/e and the f_i/f_c/L ranges, Bryson 0.37-0.60, D&C 0.16, Cassan 1.6, GCNS 331,312/(4/3 pi 100^3) = 0.0791, and the N(R) closed form (re-derived). All are correct. Labelling is exemplary: rho0 is flagged as a raw-count approximation, not the corrected 0.081; the M share 0.75 is flagged unverified (Reyle Table 3 gives about 0.74); design parameters are marked 'design'. No number is presented as exact when it is an inference, apart from N1.
